rules.statement: When valuing a deed of gift, the Commissioner of Stamps should consider any lease or mortgage that diminishes the value of the property and may deduct their effect from the valuation.
rules.supporting_quote: "The first question we have to consider is whether any deduction should be made from the valuation of the lands in respect of the lease. Obviously a donor has the right to gift any kind of property whether movable or immovable (see section 3 (22))."
